pageDescription: See which apps are holding your ports and end them to free ports up. Ports are used by apps that listen for connections — a busy port can block a server or dev tool from starting.
unavailableDescription: Port Manager is coming to Windows in a future update.
adminTooltip: Owned by another user — ending it requires running Clarity as administrator
emptyDescription: Try scanning again or adjust your filters.
idleDescription: Scan now to see the ports currently in use.
confirmKillDescription: This sends a graceful terminate signal (SIGTERM), then force-quits if the process ignores it. Any unsaved work in the affected apps will be lost.
confirmAdminWarning: Some selected processes require administrator rights and will fail to end.
killAdminNeeded: Run Clarity as administrator to end this process.
requiresAdminToast: Some processes require administrator rights to end.
